name: FLA_LEASE_INCREMENT_LINES
description: FLA_LEASE_INCREMENT_LINES contains payment increase lines for the lease payment which is part of the payment increase agreement

columns.name: LEASE_INCREMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique payment increase line identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. It is referenced from the FLA_LEASE_PAYMENT_HEADERS table.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement number. It is referenced from the FLA_INCREMENT_HEADERS table.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment increase assessment will be performed.

columns.name: INCREASE_LINE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the payment increase line.

columns.name: INCREASE_LINE_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the payment increase line.

columns.name: INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Increase percent captured for the payment increase line.

columns.name: BASIS_FACTOR_PERCENT
columns.description: Basis factor percent which is applicable for the payment increase line.

columns.name: BASE_PAYMENT_BASIS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Average base payment basis amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: CUM_BASIS_INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative increase amount captured for the payment increase till this payment period. This is applicable if basis is compounding.

columns.name: FINAL_BASIS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Final basis amount which is applicable for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: TOTAL_PAYMENT_BASIS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total payment basis amount for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Increase amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contingent amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: NON_CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Noncontingent amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative contingent amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_IMPACT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates schedules are impacted and need to be regenerated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEMS_IMPACT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates payment items are impacted and need to be regenerated.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Parent record identifier. This identifies the parent record for this record.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
